name: generic
why: Keys that name pack ids the same way in every plugin: item components (item_model, tooltip_style, equippable.asset_id, sound events) and text (font). Read against the 26.2 client: DataComponents item_model/tooltip_style/equippable, Style.font. The last rule reads a namespaced id under any other key as an item definition (a plugin naming a generator item as nexo:<id>): quiet, so it shows only where it matches the pack.
